name: ModelAI Sepsis 2019 Frozen Symbolic Specification
prediction_target: SepsisLabel at each hour; labels are shifted 6 h before clinical sepsis onset by the challenge organizers.
design_principles: Only current and past measurements may be used at hour t.
Missing evidence is represented explicitly as UNKNOWN, never as inactive/normal.
Baseline and ModelAI arms receive identical raw values, observation masks, and time-since-last-observation features.
Symbolic thresholds are frozen before held-out evaluation.
Literature-backed clinical thresholds are separated from engineering-only temporal persistence rules.
State transitions require fresh/evaluable evidence; UNKNOWN cannot count as a positive confirmation.

alerts.name: MAP_SEVERE
alerts.source_basis: Septic-shock perfusion target / operational severity threshold

alerts.name: MAP_FALLING
alerts.rule: current MAP < 75 AND drop >=10 mmHg from max of previous 3 observed hours
alerts.source_basis: engineering trajectory rule; not a diagnostic criterion

alerts.name: LACTATE_ELEVATED
alerts.source_basis: Sepsis-3 septic-shock metabolic criterion (dataset values empirically align with mmol/L scale)

alerts.name: LACTATE_RISING
alerts.rule: increase >=0.5 from most recent prior observed lactate within 6 h

alerts.name: CREATININE_RISING
alerts.rule: increase >=0.3 mg/dL from minimum prior value in previous 24 h
alerts.source_basis: engineering conservative AKI-like trajectory rule; 24 h window chosen to fit hourly data

alerts.name: SIRS_PAIR
alerts.rule: at least 2 evaluable active among Temp dysregulation, HR > 90, Resp > 20 or PaCO2 < 32, WBC dysregulation
alerts.source_basis: historical SIRS construct; used only as an alert, not as sepsis definition

entry_logic.DYSFUNCTION: 2-of-last-3 evaluable hours with A02 or A03, or concurrent A01+A04
entry_logic.SEVERE: A03 plus A10 when both are evaluable, or persistent A03 in 2-of-last-3 evaluable hours
entry_logic.RECOVERING: previous DYSFUNCTION/SEVERE and 2 consecutive evaluable hours without A02/A03/A04

entry_logic.DYSFUNCTION: persistent A05 or A06 in 2-of-last-3 evaluable hours, or A07
entry_logic.SEVERE: A07 plus A06, or metabolic/respiratory acidosis with respiratory abnormality
entry_logic.RECOVERING: 2 consecutive evaluable hours without active respiratory alerts after dysfunction

entry_logic.SEVERE: Creatinine >=3.5 when evaluable, or persistent A13+A14
entry_logic.RECOVERING: falling creatinine with no A14 across two fresh observations

entry_logic.DYSFUNCTION: A20 or persistence of A08/A09 across fresh observations
entry_logic.RECOVERING: two fresh/evaluable observations without inflammatory alerts
improving fresh measurements across two observations

entry_logic.SEVERE: Lactate >=4 when evaluable, or persistent combined metabolic abnormalities

entry_logic.MULTISYSTEM_CONCERN: two domain machines >=AT_RISK within current/previous 2 h
entry_logic.PROGRESSIVE_MULTIORGAN: two or more domain machines worsen state within previous 6 h OR one dysfunctional domain plus a second newly abnormal domain
entry_logic.HIGH_RISK: three or more domain machines >=DYSFUNCTION, or progressive multiorgan plus elevated lactate/hypotension
entry_logic.RECOVERING: prior high-risk/progressive state with net state improvement across >=2 domain machines and no new worsening transition

trajectory_features: transition count in previous 6 h and 24 h
reachable-next-state one-hot under frozen transition graph
controls: raw-only baseline with identical raw measurements, masks, time-since-last-observation, static variables and model backbone
